optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Vendor Management Analyst, Cloud Software Procurement
professionalSummary: Vendor management analyst with three years experience preparing vendor reviews and renewal analyses for approximately forty cloud and software vendors annually under the procurement team’s review template.
experienceHighlights: Prepared vendor reviews and renewal analyses for about forty vendors a year using the procurement team’s review template.
Maintained the vendor risk register with the security team’s assessments, updating it after each security review and contract change.
Ran the renewal calendar and prepared negotiation briefs for the procurement manager; negotiation decisions and contract signatures remained with the manager and were recorded on the renewal record.
Coordinated renewal inputs with the finance business partner through the renewal record, clearly recording which figures were mine and which were finance’s.
Wrote the open items note and hand‑over conditions for each renewal in the renewal record’s closure section.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Work sample: one vendor review, one renewal analysis with its negotiation brief and the manager’s decision record, and the vendor risk register extract for one quarter, with procurement system references as a verification trail.
skills: Documentation of renewal open items and hand‑over conditions
